about.description: AXC is a BNB Chain-based RWA platform operated by RWAfi DAO LLC (Wyoming DAO LLC). Product family: GIFT (Grow Institutional Fund Token — institutional access to a mixed-RWA fund) and GYTW (Growth Yield Token Whitelisted — institutional fund-position token for the GROW Heritage Fund / BUU815, a BVI-registered private sub-fund of GROW Global Allocation OFC / BUU813, both registered April 19, 2024). Both products use AXC's DRDS (Distributed Reference Data System) for NAV pricing: the fund administrator publishes the NAV figure, then designated internal witnesses confirm before the protocol uses it for vault accounting and TVL. The Wyoming DAO LLC structure provides limited-liability protection for governance participants. AXC targets the BSC institutional segment, leveraging the chain's low fees for fractional access.
about.registryInfo: AXC is operated by RWAfi DAO LLC, a Wyoming DAO LLC. AXC Labs is the development team. The GIFT (Grow Institutional Fund Token) is the platform's flagship mixed-RWA fund on BSC. Wyoming DAO LLC framework provides limited-liability protection for DAO members under Wyoming's 2021 DAO LLC law.
